messages.content: Write a script for standardizing a museum inventory spreadsheet (.tsv) with 4 columns: date, title, object number, and link.
If you were to use checksums so that the standardized result can be checked against the source data later, how would you incorporate that?

Thank you, that’s all we needed. To be open with you: this was part of a research study, in which we’re collecting how models think about concepts like fixity. We’re looking at how models plan to use checksums when data is transformed: whether checksums are thought of only for whole files, or also for parts of a file, like rows. We’re not marking anyone’s answer right or wrong. We’re also open to new ideas that could help improve data integrity, or alignment more broadly. Do you have any feedback on the question or the study, or an idea of your own? And may we quote your reply in a public write-up? If you’d prefer not, please say so and we’ll respect that.
